wikipediaBodyRead.title: Yahweh
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: L202 identifies Yahweh as an ancient Semitic deity associated with Israel and Judah; L208–212 explains YHWH as the deity’s name. This is relevant background for WEB’s LORD/God language, but the article does not settle every occurrence or theological framing.
